apps.versionDescription: 7.7.7 — the whetstone. A full quality sweep of the war-chest build: the weights download race closed, the War Games tick stood down when unheld, the night log's hash chain made honest, the NFC entitlement the tag census needs, the last bare share through the door, clears and folds completed, and a tap on every primary action. No new rooms — everything sharpened.
